posts.name: Johnthebaptistpreacher
posts.cooked:
For me the Freedom Five Animated Series will always have a special place in my heart. Though I also loved the classic black and white Legacy. Even though he sprouted new unknown powers every episode, and after shrugging off a hail of bullets ducked when the mobsters threw their gun at him. I just love that classic newsreel intro. “High above Megalopolis, a suited savior soars. Faster than a galloping stallion, stronger than a truck, and more handsome than clark gable. It’s an American Legacy!”

I’ve heard that Schmetflix might be doing a set of TV-MA shows based on the members of Dark Watch and if they do well then maybe a team up show as well. Excited to get to see Mr. Fixer. Rumor is that they have already started casting for Setback.
